description: This file contains the implementation of Lua integration functions for the lighttpd web server. It includes functions for managing Lua states, error handling, environment setup, and binding of various Lua modules and constants related to request processing, including hash functions and lifecycle management.

classes.name: liLuaState
classes.description: Struct representing the Lua state used within lighttpd for request handling and scripting.

methods.name: liLuaState * li_lua_state_get(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Retrieves the current Lua state associated with a lua_State object.

methods.name: int li_lua_fixindex(lua_State * L,int ndx)
methods.description: Replaces negative stack index with positive, making it easier to refer to Lua stack elements.

methods.name: int traceback(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Generates a traceback string for error messages.

methods.name: int li_lua_push_traceback(lua_State * L,int nargs)
methods.description: Sets up the Lua traceback function on the stack.

methods.name: gboolean li_lua_call_object(liServer * srv,liVRequest * vr,lua_State * L,const char * method,int nargs,int nresults,gboolean optional)
methods.description: Calls a Lua function corresponding to an object method with provided arguments and handles errors.

methods.name: int li_lua_metatable_index(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Performs a raw meta-method lookup for an object.

methods.name: void li_lua_push_globals(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Pushes the global table onto the Lua stack.

methods.name: void li_lua_set_globals(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Sets the global table from the top of the Lua stack.

methods.name: void create_environment(liLuaState * LL)
methods.description: Creates a new Lua environment with specific metatables and storage.

methods.name: void li_lua_environment_activate_ephemeral(liLuaState * LL)
methods.description: Activates a new ephemeral environment for a Lua state, saving previous environment.

methods.name: int li_lua_environment_create(liLuaState * LL,liVRequest * vr)
methods.description: Creates a new environment and optionally associates it with a request.

methods.name: void li_lua_environment_activate(liLuaState * LL,int env_mt_ref)
methods.description: Activates a previously created environment in a Lua state.

methods.name: void li_lua_environment_restore(liLuaState * LL)
methods.description: Restores the previous environment.

methods.name: void li_lua_environment_use_globals(liLuaState * LL)
methods.description: Sets the environment's globals to the current global table.

methods.name: void li_lua_environment_restore_globals(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Restores the globals to previous state.

methods.name: const char * li_lua_tolstring(lua_State * L,liServer * srv,liVRequest * vr,int idx,size_t * len)
methods.description: Converts a Lua value at a given index to a string, handling different types and errors.

methods.name: GString * li_lua_print_get_string(lua_State * L,liServer * srv,liVRequest * vr,int from,int to)
methods.description: Concatenates string representations of multiple Lua stack values into a GString buffer.

methods.name: int li_lua_error(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Logs an error message from Lua.

methods.name: int li_lua_warning(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Logs a warning message from Lua.

methods.name: int li_lua_info(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Logs an informational message from Lua.

methods.name: int li_lua_debug(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Logs a debug message from Lua.

methods.name: int li_lua_md5(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Computes the MD5 checksum of a string from the Lua stack.

methods.name: int li_lua_sha1(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Computes the SHA1 checksum of a string from the Lua stack.

methods.name: int li_lua_sha256(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Computes the SHA256 checksum of a string from the Lua stack.

methods.name: int li_lua_path_simplify(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Simplifies a filesystem path string.

methods.name: void li_lua_init2(liLuaState * LL,liServer * srv,liWorker * wrk)
methods.description: Initializes the Lua state by setting up built-in modules, constants, and environment.

methods.name: int ghashtable_gstring_next(lua_State * L)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: int li_lua_ghashtable_gstring_pairs(lua_State * L,GHashTable * ht)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void li_lua_push_lighty_constants(lua_State * L,int ndx)
methods.description: unavailable

ctags.name: li_lua_call_object
ctags.pattern: /^gboolean li_lua_call_object(liServer *srv, liVRequest *vr, lua_State *L, const char* method, int/
ctags.signature: (liServer * srv,liVRequest * vr,lua_State * L,const char * method,int nargs,int nresults,gboolean optional)

ctags.name: li_lua_environment_restore
ctags.pattern: /^void li_lua_environment_restore(liLuaState *LL) \/* -1 (expects previous metatable to restore on/

ctags.name: li_lua_print_get_string
ctags.pattern: /^GString* li_lua_print_get_string(lua_State *L, liServer *srv, liVRequest *vr, int from, int to) /

ctags.name: li_lua_tolstring
ctags.pattern: /^static const char *li_lua_tolstring(lua_State *L, liServer *srv, liVRequest *vr, int idx, size_t/
